app.name: Orbit
root.short: Orbit — cloud certificate orchestration and inspection
status.short: Read-only inventory of certificates, resources and to-dos
clean.short: Remove certificates no cloud resource uses
account.short: Manage Tencent Cloud accounts and credentials
doctor.short: Environment self-check: config, credentials, access, locales
flag.products: Products to use (comma separated, e.g. cdn,teo)
flag.dry_run: Only build the plan; never write to the cloud
flag.fail_on_changes: Exit with code 3 when plan mode found changes
flag.include_free: Allow cleaning free certificates (off by default)
flag.backup_dir: Directory used to back up before deletion
flag.demo: Use built-in demo data (no Tencent Cloud access)
flag.experimental_write: Allow strategies that are not verified yet
flag.no_tui: Disable the TUI and print plain text
plan.title: Execution plan
plan.empty: Nothing to do: every domain already uses the best certificate.
plan.summary: {total} change(s): {apply} to apply, {uptodate} up to date, {nocert} without a usable certificate
clean.title: Cleanup plan
clean.reason.not_superseded: no better certificate for its domains (may still be in use)
clean.reason.free: free certificates are not cleaned by default
msg.plan_only: The above is a dry run; nothing was written. Re-run with --yes to apply.
doctor.title: Environment self-check
account.none: No account registered yet; run orbit account add first.
account.exists: Account {alias} already exists; add --force to overwrite.
err.credentials_mode: Credential file is too permissive (mode {mode}); run chmod 600 {path}
err.accounts_ambiguous: Multiple accounts found and this is not an interactive terminal; use --accounts or --all-accounts.
err.provider_unimplemented: The {platform} provider is not implemented yet (arrives in M1); use --demo for sample data.
err.no_accounts: No account is registered in the configuration.
err.invalid_products: Unsupported product: {value} (this batch supports: cdn, teo)
err.gate_experimental: Strategy {strategy} is not verified yet; pass --enable-experimental-write.
account.add.short: Register an account and store its credentials
config.set.short: Set a configuration value, e.g. language=en-US
core.reason.first_bind: the domain has no certificate yet
core.reason.no_cert: no usable certificate matches this domain
core.reason.edgeone_free_cert_kept: domain uses an EdgeOne free certificate; kept by configuration
core.reason.experimental_blocked: strategy is not verified yet; pass --enable-experimental-write
clean.reason.in_use: still referenced by a cloud resource
err.account_needs_input: Cannot read credentials non-interactively; use --from-stdin or environment variables.
cloud.err.role_missing: Service role not authorised: grant SSL_QCSLinkedRoleInReplaceLoadCertificate and retry
cloud.err.cert_mismatch: Certificate does not match the domain: check that its SAN covers the target
cloud.err.cert_expired: Certificate is expired or not yet valid; finish uploading/issuing it first
cloud.err.no_icp: Domain has no ICP filing (sync takes about 2 hours); it was skipped
cloud.err.pending_record: An in-flight deploy task already exists for this certificate and resource type; retry later
cloud.err.rate_limited: Cloud rate limit hit; Orbit backed off automatically — lower concurrency if it persists
cloud.err.region_required: This resource type requires a region (internal error, please report)
cloud.err.region_invalid: Region was rejected (internal error, please report)
cloud.err.deploy_failed: Deploy task failed; check the RequestId and the console
cloud.err.verify_failed: Write submitted but read-back did not confirm it; re-check with status later
cloud.err.not_found: Target not found or not owned by this account (domain/site/certificate)
cloud.err.delete_kept_bound: Still referenced by a cloud resource; kept, not deleted
cloud.err.delete_kept_timeout: Association query timed out; kept due to insufficient evidence
cloud.err.delete_role_missing: Deletion needs service role authorisation; nothing was deleted
cloud.err.no_real_name: Account has not completed real-name verification; certificates cannot be deployed
cloud.err.unknown: Unexpected cloud error; please report it together with the RequestId
cloud.err.auth_failed: Credentials are invalid or expired: check SecretId / SecretKey (AuthFailure)
cloud.err.no_permission: This account has no permission for this product, or the product is not activated (AdministratorAccess does not activate a service); the error above names the failing API and account
scan.refused: Some products could not be scanned, so the cleanup evidence is incomplete; refusing to run. Re-run with --permit-partial-scan to force it.
progress.wait.bindings: association query still running: {pending} task(s) pending, waited {waited}
progress.repeat_hint: note: the first scan needs a live association query (minutes); status reuses the cloud's 30-minute cache and is much faster afterwards
flag.progress: Force scan progress output (on by default in a terminal)
cloud.err.evidence_incomplete: Some certificates' association queries did not finish in time (incomplete evidence): cleanup will skip them
progress.bindings.first_run: note: the live association query is an async cloud task and can take minutes on the first run (cap {timeout}); status reuses a 30-minute cache afterwards
flag.no_cache: Ignore the cloud's association cache and query live (slower)
progress.teo.zone_skipped: site {zone} (type {type}) is not part of certificate deployment; skipped
